items.html: And thus are explained the three names that are in the upper head, called the Keter, the skull of AA, and they are: in the secret of the inner light, and a surrounding [light], and yet another surrounding [light] upon both of them. However, in relation to the generality of the rest of the heads, all these three discernments are only the aspect of the upper surrounding light of all of them, and it is Neshama.
